reason: An identifiable patient with 48 years of treatment-resistant pain reached pain-free periods and regained phantom movement. The case gives no long-term follow-up, so a durable life-changing effect is not established.
Single case. The same group later ran a 14-patient trial. No population effect is documented.
High-school students in CTAI schools gained about 0.20 SD in the second year (RAND brief; EEPA abstract).
Adopting schools gained a second-year effect under conditions similar to independent adoption (EEPA abstract).
In 142 blinded inspections the nEmesis arm found 9 vs 6 demerits per inspection (p = 0.019). It found 11 vs 7 venues graded C or worse, an unpermitted seafood establishment and a sick food handler.

The 71 infections and 4.4 hospitalizations said to be saved are estimates from CDC outbreak averages. The drop in foodborne-illness investigations (5 vs 11) is an uncontrolled year-on-year comparison, not a measured outcome.
The sources document a retrospective simulation (69% vs 55% found in the first half; 7.5 days earlier) and no live-deployment outcome.
Earlier discovery “potentially after patrons became ill” is stated as a rationale. No illness outcome is documented.
Outcomes are cohort means on daily-living and task tests. No individual beneficiary is identified.
Multi-site cohort evidence of usability, not an attributable societal outcome.
Lottery winners gained 0.37 SD in math and 0.23 SD in Hindi over 4.5 months (AER abstract, J-PAL summary).
The deployer gained independent evidence for the center model at about INR 1,000 per student per month (J-PAL summary).
Xcel's US$49 million estimate and the error reduction to 10.8% are reported by the makers and the press without independent measurement.
Ratepayer savings and coal-unit decommitment are reported as estimates. No audited figure is documented.
The report gives aggregate identified savings for CMS with no single attributable case.
Savings to the Medicare program are stated only as yearly aggregates mixing actual denials with projected avoidance.
The gains are group means (SRS-2 and Vineland), with no individually attributed outcome.
Trial evidence of efficacy comparable to standard care, not a measured societal change.
Kiribati secured a US$1 million fine against Central Pacific Fishing Company plus a US$1 million goodwill grant (Grist). The BBC piece puts the total at US$2 million, about 1% of the country's GDP.
No source documents subsequent fishing pressure or deterrence inside the protected area.
Sole means of communication outdoors and, over seven years, increasing at-home use as eye-gaze control was lost.
No organizational outcome reported.
Single participant.
No individually attributable outcome: the source reports cross-validated classification accuracy (95.6%) on 185 children, not what followed for any child.
The study reports cohort-level rate reductions, not an individually attributable outcome.
The study reports cohort-level rate reductions without individually attributable outcomes.
No cited source documents an outcome for a foreign patient. The sources describe capability and rollout only.
No cited source gives adoption counts or usage outcomes for fire headquarters. Ninomiya Town's page records adoption, not results.
The source reports no outcome for the 7.5 million targeted children. Any benefit is indirect and unquantified.
Mapping area reduced from 94,080 km² to 2,745 km² and the base map completed in a fraction of the normal time.
A supporting role in one national campaign whose coverage effect was not measured.

One identifiable participant gained brain-controlled walking simulation and eight-degree-of-freedom arm control, exercised at home with an avatar and in the lab with the exoskeleton. It did not yet provide everyday mobility.
Single-patient proof of concept for semi-invasive long-term BCI. No population effect.
No individual beneficiary is identified in either source.

Material to DNIT and TCU: both cited sources state that the tender(s) were blocked or canceled by acórdão after the Alice alert. The amount is given as R$39 million (two notices) by Inforchannel and R$20 million (one notice) by JOTA.
A single highway tender among some 60,000 federal tenders a year, small at national scale.
Only OPTiM's announcement exists. No trial result, alert count or staffing effect was published.
No passenger safety outcome is documented.
Raleigh PD officials credit faster linkage of victims and suspects, but no case outcome is documented.
No individually attributable victim outcome in the sources.
Treated students were 3.3 percentage points more likely to enroll on time (ERIC abstract; Brookings).
The abstract reports enrollment impacts comparable to prior interventions with substantially reduced burden on university staff.

NASA's Paul Hertz said that discoveries were lurking in archived Kepler data awaiting the right tool. The archive yielded two newly validated planets without new telescope observations by the authors. Their validation used Kepler data and follow-up observations that other observers had already uploaded to the Kepler Community Follow-up Program.

Astronomy gained a validated eighth planet and the first exoplanetary system known to have eight planets, tying the Solar System. This is a knowledge gain for a specialist community rather than a population-level benefit.

A young woman not breathing during a seizure had paramedics summoned by her mother on the device's alert and is reported alive and well. A potentially life-saving response documented only in one news report.
No cited source documents a child reunited with a family as a result of the 2,930 matches. The High Court recorded on 22 January 2019 that the software had not cracked any missing-child case.
The police reported 2,930 identities “established” to the ministry. The same police told the court four months later that the software produced only a two percent match.
The court's own figures (5,160 children untraced of 19,916 reported in 2016–2018) are the context. No reduction attributable to the software is documented.
No farmer outcome, accuracy figure or adoption figure appears in the sources.
FAO describes the intended data flow into FAMEWS; no result is reported.
Households had lead or galvanized lines replaced faster under model-guided targeting (6,228 replacements through 2017). Outcomes are documented in aggregate, no individual named.
FAST Start's hit rate was 70 percent through 2017, above 80 percent in late 2017 per McDaniel, against 15 percent in 2018 without the model. The KDD paper reports 91.6% holdout accuracy.
Flint's court-ordered lead-removal mandate was served faster while the model guided digs. The Atlantic reports thousands of homes kept lead pipes longer after it was dropped.
An attempt to enter the United States on another person's genuine passport was stopped and the traveler removed. Sources document no further threat beyond the document fraud.
CBP gained a verified first detection for a system then three days into use at Dulles. Subsequent releases report repeated catches.

The evidence is aggregate (sensitivity, time-to-recognition, trial-level recognition rates) with no individually attributable changed outcome. The randomized trial found no significant improvement in dispatcher recognition.
A capability study and a null randomized trial. No discrete organizational event with an observed outcome is documented.
Breakthrough Listen recovered 72 additional bursts from an existing 400-terabyte Green Bank dataset without new telescope time.
The FRB research community gained a much larger burst sample (93 pulses in five hours) from the only known repeating FRB at the time.
69 of 132 FINDER-prompted inspections (52.3%) found an unsafe restaurant versus 2,662 of 10,786 (24.7%) baseline inspections. Odds ratio 3.06 (95% CI 2.14–4.35), adjusted for city and risk level.
The paper argues that corrective actions “would prevent” spread of foodborne illness but documents no reduction in illness.

The ranger force's monthly snare removals rose from a reported two or three hundred to over one thousand. A material gain in patrol effectiveness for the operating team. A chi-squared test confirmed predictions discriminated risk (p = 0.023).

Over one thousand snares were removed from a sanctuary identified as a tiger-reintroduction site. The paper states each snare “represents the life of one animal potentially saved”. A material landscape-scale conservation benefit rather than a documented population-level change.
Althingi replaced first-stage manual transcription with ASR drafts graded Good for 77% of speeches, with about 640 hours transcribed by November 2019.
Vísir reported on 4 March 2018 that the recognizer was released under an open-source license for Icelandic-language developers. A small, diffuse benefit.
Flagged-report counts and confession rates are police aggregates with no independent confirmation.
No measured effect on insurance fraud or police resources is documented.

Reductions in time below 54–55 mg/dL are reported for user populations, mostly in Dexcom's own analyses. No individual event with a changed outcome is documented. The one independent case report found ULS alone insufficient.
No payer, clinic or health-system outcome is reported in the sources.

One woman with a recent TIA received an ECG-confirmed AF diagnosis, rate control and anticoagulation. A material benefit to one person. Several echoes (VT ablation with defibrillator, pacemaker for heart block) are deeper but are not the event.
Material benefit to one identifiable person: first decoding of his own full words, three times faster than his pointer typing. But limited to a 50-word vocabulary in research sessions.
A child sold for weeks was recovered and removed from trauma, per Thorn's CEO. No independent confirmation of the recovery is among the sources.
No individual beneficiary is identified in any cited source.
Indonesian authorities and INTERPOL obtained a capture, a conviction and a forfeiture. No cited source attributes any part of the result to an AI output.
One blacklisted vessel removed from Southern Ocean fishing. The contribution of any AI system is undocumented and the deterrent effect is not quantified.
Approval and pricing effects are reported as aggregate rates over Upstart's applicant pool, with no individually attributable outcome.
Sources describe aggregate access effects and later disparities; no societal outcome is measured.

An injured hiker stranded on a ledge at night was located and brought out the same night. Injuries are reported inconsistently (fractured back per NBC News, fractured hand per ABC7). Whether he could have called 911 himself is not addressed.
Middletown police say three agencies responded to the automated call. No statement on search time saved is among the sources.
Effects on borrowers are reported as vintage-level shares and spreads, not as outcomes for identifiable individuals.
Financial-inclusion effects are discussed at the aggregate level only.

A biopsy-confirmed stage 1A melanoma was excised, further tests found no spread and he is reported cancer-free. He calls it life-saving, but stage 1A is early disease and no clinician is quoted on prognosis. How long he would otherwise have waited is his own estimate.
The patient learned from her watch, and had confirmed by Holter, that her rhythm had reverted at 19:29. The report records no change in management, so the benefit is informational only.

A 400-year-old oak struck two cars at the bonnet. Eight people walked away with, at worst, two black eyes, a bump on the head and bruising. Both drivers and the Mirror call it life-saving. But that rests on the drivers' accounts, no telemetry or official assessment is reported, and the second driver was unsure the brakes were enabled.
The sources document in vitro and murine results and independent laboratory confirmation. No individually attributable real-world outcome such as a treated patient or an approved drug.

By his account and the footage as described, one driver was moved out of a wrong-way car's path at about 60 mph before he reacted. The other driver also swerved onto the median, so whether a collision would have occurred is unknown. No avoided injury or damage can be measured.
Thirteen patients had early, resectable lung cancer diagnosed and operated on. Seven were stage I and needed no further treatment. A survival benefit is plausible but not demonstrated in the paper.
Eight patients were seen by a pulmonologist on the day of the radiograph, before the formal report, shortening the diagnostic pathway.
Arisat's reported rise from 0.5 kg to 2.0 to 5.0 kg per plant is a measurable improvement in her harvest. It comes only from the developer's blog, with no independent source.
No fall, alert or prevented accident is reported by any source.
The operator describes the intended staff workflow; no count of alerts, false alarms or staff time saved is published.
Simulation results only. No live operational outcome is documented.
No collision avoided or reduced is documented.
No individual outcome is documented.
Net-profit gains (17% in 2018; 3.10–6.86 €/m² versus a lower reference in 2020) are from 96 m² experimental compartments. They use the organizers' price and cost model, not a grower's accounts.
Resource-use differences are reported per compartment; no wider outcome is documented.

One driver kept control of his car after swerving around a wild boar at 4 am and arrived unhurt. By his account the car straightened the swerve he had begun. Whether he would have lost control or struck the animal without that correction is unknown. No avoided injury or damage is measured, so a removed risk is not established.

A young worker's band documented a 188 bpm tachycardia. With a routine ECG showing WPW the next day and her symptoms, it backed referral for electrophysiology study. Successful radiofrequency catheter ablation came 11 days after the recorded episode. A material benefit to one person, though the diagnosis itself came from the routine ECG.
No use of the predictions by FAO, DLCO-EA or national control centers is documented in the paper.
No field outcome is reported.
No litigant outcome is documented.
General benefit. The processing-time claim is a developer statement at launch and the system was in testing in April 2021.
General benefit. No effect on tutela selection quality or timeliness is documented.
No outcome is documented.
No outcome is documented.
No outcome is documented.

Shipping lines' cooperation rates (59% of distance in 2023 per KCBX; 85% fleet cooperation in a 2024 BWBS report) are program-wide figures. No source attributes a change in any operator's behavior to Whale Safe's ratings or report cards.
Strike-risk reductions (about 50% in 2024, 40% against a 2016 baseline in 2025) are BWBS's modeled estimates for participating vessels, not counts of whales saved. None is attributed to Whale Safe.

A child separated from his parents for five years, living in an institution in another state, was identified and returned to his family. The sources describe the match as having “changed the lives of the child and his parents”.
Two identified participants regained independent texting, shopping and money management at home. An eye-tracker handled cursor navigation, so the BCI's own contribution is the click control.
First-in-human feasibility in two people. Later SWITCH follow-up covered four patients with no serious adverse events, still a small cohort.
Five mobile-money installments of 8,170 CFA (women) or 7,000 CFA (men) to each of 138,531 rural beneficiaries during COVID-19 restrictions (World Bank study, Table 1).
The Government of Togo delivered shock-responsive rural assistance without a social registry. The World Bank documents the model as a reusable case study.
Material to many: 138,531 rural beneficiaries reached, and the Nature evaluation reports exclusion errors 4–21% lower than geographic targeting.

COV-BARRIER reported 28-day all-cause mortality of 8% (62 patients) on baricitinib versus 13% (100 patients) on placebo, hazard ratio 0.57. The randomized comparison supports a life-preserving treatment benefit.
ACTT-2 showed median recovery falling from 8 to 7 days overall and from 18 to 10 days on high-flow oxygen or non-invasive ventilation. That materially eased hospital burden.
WHO strongly recommended baricitinib for severe or critical COVID-19 on 14 January 2022. That made the AI-proposed drug part of standard pandemic care at population scale.
No individually attributable outcome: the sources report classifier accuracy (80.6% recall) and aggregate use (over 200,000 people), not what followed a screening result.
No outcome documented for the 60 participating schools or the other organizations beyond supplying participants.
Farmers scored 18–31% on diagnosis. The paper reports only a “slight increase” in extension workers' skill after two weeks and no yield or income outcome.
No deployment outcome for extension services is documented beyond the accuracy comparison.

Life-changing benefit to one identifiable person: standing, walking, stair climbing and independent home use restored after ten years of paralysis. Some recovery persists when the device is switched off.
Aggregate program figure with no discrete attributable event.
The R$426 million is an annual total of control benefits credited to the Alice system, not a single verified event.
Aggregate. The TCU's own benefit-measurement methodology, not an independent evaluation.

Households in selected wards were beneficiaries of the government's COVID-CT. The PNAS authors say disbursement began mid-January 2021. The World Bank ISR records 49,000 beneficiary households as of 15 October 2021 without saying how many had been paid.
NASSCO stood up an urban registry within months through USSD self-registration guided by the ML poverty map. Over 1.75 million registrations succeeded (PAD, Nov 2021).
Material to many: 1,163 wards with over 20 million residents made eligible. PNAS simulation finds the ML maps would cut inclusion errors by 61.7% versus the survey-based benchmark.
Aggregate statistical effect across subscribed areas, no discrete attributable event.
Effect measured at the level of subscribed administrative areas and concessions.
Continent-level reduction estimate with no single identifiable beneficiary.
No user, ministry or FAO confirmation of an alert received or acted on.
No evaluation of forecast skill or of crop losses avoided.

The report records reviews of around 100 customer relationships. It also records a third linked company whose review revealed potential money laundering concerns. Losses avoided are estimated, not observed.
The foreword's statement about neutralizing mule account networks is general and not tied to a documented outcome.
Users are described (a translator who found errors, a voice contributor planning to use it for her husband's learning). No measured benefit for any person is documented.
The Government of Nunavut's and Microsoft's stated uses (healthcare communication, Office email, compliance with language law) are expectations without reported data.
Language-vitality effects are asserted by officials. VICE notes Inuktut use fell from 72 to 65 percent between 2001 and 2016, without any link to the tool.
Reduced eagle fatalities are an aggregate estimate whose size is disputed; no individually attributable outcome is documented.
The operator's benefit (fewer protected-species fatalities) is not quantified independently of the disputed estimate.
No individual outcome is documented.
The West Sumatra patrol's reported easier work is not tied to a dated alert or action.
RFCx's hectare figures are self-reported aggregates with no independent evaluation.
No pedestrian was shown at risk and no falling object occurred; the only documented trigger was a reporter's test, so no outcome is documented.

Jiefang Daily reports 995 door/window alerts handled in January to May 2021. It says that over 80% were visitors trying the devices and that real events were far fewer. No efficiency measure is given.

After two miscarriages, hypoglycemia frequency and glucose variability fell on the device and the pregnancy reached term with a healthy infant. A life-changing benefit, though the source does not prove the device caused the live birth.
Residents and building managers receive timed alerts, but no individual outcome is documented.
A municipal proclamation and partner alert program were adopted; the partner page reports no measured change in collisions at Houston buildings.
The collision evidence is a Chicago study co-authored by BirdCast scientists; Houston's own collision change is unmeasured.
Small: a new scholarly finding for Dead Sea Scrolls research published after peer review; no institutional change reported
Small: knowledge about the production of one manuscript; the sources claim no wider effect
Aggregate engagement effect; no individual health outcome documented in the field study.
The efficiency gain in call allocation is an aggregate program result.
No population-level outcome documented.

FAO states that East African control operations prevented the loss of 4 million tonnes of cereal and 800 million liters of milk. FAO says they protected 36.6 million people's food security. The Times quotes FAO's USD 1.5 billion averted since February 2020. These are estimates for the whole operation; AI data handling was one part.

FAO received up to 2,500 records a day with nearly 25 percent unusable. PlantVillage's AI removed the unwanted data. Over 240,000 records were collected in a year from scouts and citizens who could not have used the discontinued eLocust3 tablets.
No individually documented farmer outcome in the sources.

The abstract states that the watch prompted the patient's readmission for postoperative pulmonary embolism investigation and management, a serious condition caught in time. The outcome is not detailed, and details are limited to the abstract.

Two identifiable participants gained tablet control, web browsing and typing at home. Use was within supervised research sessions rather than independent daily use, so the gain is material but not yet life-changing.
First human demonstration of wireless broadband iBCI use at home; a step toward practical deployment rather than a population-level change.
Visitors could see the composition complete for the first time in 300 years; a cultural benefit from a temporary display.
The museum gained a research-based reconstruction and a public exhibition.
A 65-year-old man with Alzheimer's and a stroke a day earlier lay unconscious in two-meter grass after over 24 hours outdoors. He was found and handed to the ambulance service alive.
GOPR Bieszczady closed a search that police, dogs and ground teams had not resolved, in what it called the first such find in Poland.
Taxpayers who corrected claims are not individually documented; the page gives no individual outcome beyond the aggregate prompt count.
The ATO's own estimate of about $37 million revenue impact from one tax time, with no independent verification and no comparison with total collections given.
Protects public revenue at modest scale: prompts reached 7.5% of myTax users and the stated impact is an estimate.
No identifiable individual beneficiary; patients benefit only indirectly through preserved hospital budgets.
Material to the hospitals and the federal budget: R$2,381,663.00 cut from one auction and about R$5.95 million from another. R$8.33 million avoided across the five audits per the CGU.
Small at national scale relative to federal purchasing of about R$119 billion a year.
No litigant outcome is documented.
OCR of 10 million pages is a throughput figure, not a measured saving, and the classifier was not in production.
No effect on case backlog or litigants is documented.
New HFrEF identified and treated; ejection fraction 55% at four months.
No organizational outcome reported for this case.
Single case.
No activation attributable to the model's output is documented, so no individual-level outcome can be assigned to the AI.
OCHA adopted the model as its trigger and computes estimates each cycle. The only documented activation (6 November 2025) was triggered by the observational wind-speed threshold.
Pre-landfall assistance in November 2025 (WFP reports 42,100 families) is documented, but not attributed to the AI model by any cited source.
One man received a diagnosis of severe obstructive sleep apnea (3% ODI 33.6/h) from an incidental wearable signal. The paper reports no treatment or follow-up for him.
The 80% sensitivity for predicting exacerbation is a retrospective pilot result on five events, which the authors say is too small to generalize. No live alerting or changed care is documented.

An unconscious hit-and-run victim on a quiet road at night had an ambulance summoned within what Wanbao calls the golden hour. He had abrasions, a neck injury needing a collar and a suspected bleed at the back of the head. His girlfriend was told where he was. The family and the Wanbao headline call it life-saving. No clinician or official says so and a passer-by did reach him, so life-saving is not established.
Small: the Belvedere adopted and exhibited the reconstructions in 2025, per its exhibition page
Small: the public can view a color hypothesis of lost works; Smola himself called the result surprising where no color knowledge existed (Jing Daily)
Small: a sponsor-funded premiere programmed by the orchestra and broadcast live, per the orchestra's concert page
Small: one new performance and recording of a hypothetical completion; Euronews states humans chose and arranged the generated themes

The 2021 study reports population-level reductions in documented suicide attempts, admissions and ED visits for identified veterans. No individual veteran's outcome is documented, and mortality did not differ in 2021 or 2025.
Care evaluations rose from 46.1% to 87.5% of identified veterans and 98% were contacted by October 2020, per VA-authored papers. No independent audit was found.
Nextgov notes the top 0.1% tier covers only 2–3% of VA suicides and the model under-identified women; no population suicide-rate effect is shown.
Effects are small average index shifts (0.06–0.09 SD) across a trial cohort, with no individual outcome attributed to the AI.
No discrete organizational event documented.
Aggregate trial result; danger-sign care-seeking showed no significant effect.

Clinicians reported that 134 of 533 genetic diagnoses (25%) were of immediate clinical actionability, including medication changes and surveillance. That is a cohort figure and no individually attributable changed outcome is cited.

Exomiser's top five candidates together with applied panels accounted for 92% of the 490 diagnoses. That is an aggregate reduction in manual interpretation burden across the pilot rather than a discrete organizational event.
A 25% diagnostic yield across 2,183 families is reported for a national health-system pilot rather than population-wide deployment.
No patient outcome is documented.
The proof of concept was tested and reviewed but not used in live bed management.
The code is open source but no reuse outcome is documented.

A 190,000-yuan transfer to a suspected romance scammer was canceled on the reminder, a serious financial loss for one person averted on WeChat's account. The man is identified only by surname and province, no police or bank confirmation is reported, and the case date is not given.

Two identifiable patients gained prosthetic control enough for daily living activities, documented at 18-month and 2-year follow-up. The abstract has no validated functional scores, so life-changing is unsupported.
A two-patient case report demonstrating feasibility of combining osseointegration with pattern-recognition control; no population-level effect shown.
Aggregate screening yield; the sources do not document any individual's outcome attributable to the software.
Efficiency figures (NNS 38, NNT 4) are program aggregates without a discrete attributable event.
2,337 diagnoses are an aggregate program result.

One man received an ICD for ventricular tachycardia and curative resection of a lung adenocarcinoma found at stage pT2a pN0. The authors judge that without the watch the cancer would likely have grown undetected and curative surgery might not have been an option. That counterfactual is their judgment.

An unstated number of Android users near Alanya received a few seconds' audible and visual notice of the quake. AFAD and the district governor said it caused no damage or injuries. No protective action by a recipient is documented. Hürriyet reported on 7 January 2022 that most users who posted about the alert said they panicked.

The alert led to recognition of symptomatic drug-induced bradycardia and a change of antibiotic, after which her heart rate normalized. The authors say a potential adverse event was prevented but document no event that was imminent.
Chan survived a critical hemorrhage and regained an active life. Mayo credits AI with aiding diagnosis.
The Swiss Plasma Center gained a controller the paper calls a notable advance for tokamak feedback control. It brought less design effort for new configurations and new droplet experiments.
No societal outcome beyond research progress is documented.
One woman obtained an earlier diagnosis of giant cell arteritis with large vessel involvement and prompt immunosuppressive treatment that resolved her symptoms. A material benefit to one person.

A driver found with crack cocaine, cash and a pistol was convicted after the AI-flagged stop, per Carscoops. The quantities, the charges and the sentence are not in the sources on record, which do not include the Forbes report that cited court documents.
7,651 patients received real-time grading with specialist-level accuracy and 2,412 were referred.
Real-time results in primary care; field reporting notes speed gains when the system worked and rejections and connectivity problems when it did not.
No population-level vision outcome reported.
The sources give accuracy measurements and a prediction that agrees with independent re-dating of Athenian decrees. No discrete, verified downstream result is attributable to Ithaca.

The reports establish a successful implantation with the stimulator working normally and electrodes precisely placed. No reduction in seizures, follow-up or patient-reported outcome is given, so the benefit to the patient's health is not yet established.

52.5 kg of explosive assessed as PETN-RDX was seized before use. The minister said the target was Istanbul and the court convicted five men of supplying weapons to a terrorist organization. So the averted harm was potentially mass-casualty, though the specific plan was not established in the reporting.
The Hakkari police obtained a lead that produced a seizure, five arrests and five convictions. The minister counted it among 15 similar actions stopped that year.
The vendor describes customers whose social-engineering transfers of EUR 125,000 and USD 170,000 were blocked, a loss averted for each. No customer is named or independently documented.

The vendor states that a USD 500,000 (KSh 58 million) ATM fraud was stopped with arrests. It says payments up to USD 850,000 were blocked before funds left client banks. Serious losses averted if the account holds. Customers, banks and dates are not given.
No aggregate verified by a regulator is given.
No patient-management or clinical outcome was measured.
Laboratory-level accuracy was measured under study conditions, not routine field operation.
No deployment at program scale is documented.
A laboratory-scale enzyme that an independent group could pick up and reuse successfully; the sources report bench work, not production deployment.
Complete depolymerization of untreated post-consumer PET was shown only in the laboratory in both the original and the independent study. Neither source reports industrial-scale recycling.

A 29-year-old had his occluded artery reopened within 60 minutes of arrival and reports being alive with no deficits. The AI's share is the time saved in fast-tracking the cath lab team after EMS had already pre-notified the hospital and the team was ready. The thrombectomy was the treatment.
Dr Mehta states that the platform streamlines workflow and cuts time compared with the previous need to open scans at workstations.

The 17-year-old, a bullying victim living with a relative, was seen by prosecutors' psychologists, who recommended urgent support (“contención”). The sources report no coercive outcome beyond a planned review of his phone.

A public statement that a school shooting could be repeated in Paraguay was checked within a day, after local media had reported threats in schools. Police said many such alerts prove to be jokes, so no prevented harm is shown.
The paper reports extensive testing with visually impaired school children and the motivating need (three Irish Braille books). No identified pupil, date or measured gain.
Access to written Irish for the 4,701 school-age blind or visually impaired people cited from the 2016 census is the stated aim. No uptake figure is given.

Effects are cohort averages across roughly 3.6 million people's communities (fewer illness symptoms, lower medical spending). No identifiable household with an attributable changed outcome is documented.
The study estimates population-level preparedness and health effects from a randomized design. It reports no discrete event such as a named evacuation.
The collaborating laboratories obtained a model that roughly doubles structural coverage of the human NPC scaffold. That is a material advance for those groups' research programs.
A 70-MDa atomically resolved model covering over 90% of the scaffold is a durable public resource for nuclear transport research. The source reports no direct patient or population benefit.

Material to a family: Lee confirmed a previously unknown photograph of his mother at Bergen-Belsen. He found photographs of her extended family (Times of Israel, Jerusalem Post). Fixler found images of herself, her aunt and cousin (NPR)
Small gain for archives: an anonymous Yad Vashem photograph acquired an identification, but the sources record no formal archival update
Small: two documented identifications among millions of unidentified faces indexed, per the sources
No realized output of the algorithm is documented.
No recovered revenue attributable to VeRa is documented.
Targeted therapy for leptomeningeal disease started a week earlier and whole-neuraxis radiotherapy was avoided, with MRI improvement at two months. Survival benefit is not reported.
The slide-based inference let the team choose a single rapid PCR test instead of waiting for sequencing on limited tissue.

The hospital describes a patient in mortal danger from sepsis and severe pneumonia caused by a multidrug-resistant organism it says carries 33% mortality. She was on an antibiotic the model predicted ineffective. After the switch she improved within a week, was extubated and discharged, and the hospital calls the rescue timely and life-saving. This rests on the treating hospital's account at its press conference.
Cohort-level association (mortality, organ failure, length of stay) without an individually attributable event.
The study reports adjusted associations across 590,736 monitored patients, not a discrete population-level event.
Material benefit to one identifiable person: large-vocabulary communication at conversational pace in research sessions. The team itself called it a proof of concept rather than an everyday device.

Material benefit to one identifiable person: fast text, synthesized voice and avatar communication demonstrated in research sessions (run at her residence). The paper reports no independent use outside those sessions.
Yamagata University's Institute of Nasca reports a sixteen-fold increase in discovery rate, achieving in six months what DLR says previously took decades.
The known corpus of figurative geoglyphs at a UNESCO World Heritage site nearly doubled, with 303 confirmed sites added to Peru's archaeological record.

A pulmonary embolism with bilateral DVT was diagnosed and anticoagulated after hospital oximetry had been normal. A life-changing benefit, though the source does not establish that death was imminent.
No German fatality data are documented.
No operator or site outcome is documented.

One identifiable patient had a diffuse glioma found during her scan, was biopsied the next day and referred for immediate oncological treatment. That was instead of the days the authors say radiology typically needs and the longer wait before treatment. The paper reports no follow-up and no changed outcome. The “saved a life” wording is Anadolu Agency's headline, not the authors' claim.

Researchers in algebraic complexity gained new explicit decompositions that were improved upon within a week by Kauers and Moosbauer. The gains are field-restricted. Nature reports the 4x4 improvement for matrices “in a finite field” and Kauers and Moosbauer give the 5x5 record of 96 multiplications over Z2.

2,780,756 ineligible entries (22.6% of new registrations) were removed from the register used for the 2023 general election, per INEC's chairman. BusinessDay disputes completeness and regional balance.
INEC obtained a cleaned register and identified 23 of its own officers for sanctions over multiple registrations.
78 households had roofs and walls reinforced before landfall. PRC reports they mitigated wind impact (implementer survey, no counterfactual).
First completed activation of the Philippine typhoon EAP. Lessons on lead time and weather constraints documented in the final report.
Small scale: 390 people reached in one municipality.

A man with a 99% stenosis of the left anterior descending artery had it stented after the AI flagged a 72% probability of severe narrowing. He said the stent removed the sudden-death risk. He left hospital, symptoms resolved. The hospital's headlines call it life-saving, but the harm was prospective and the account is the developer-hospital's own, so life-saving is not established.
A correct molecular diagnosis replaced a misdiagnosis held since age four. The report documents no treatment change, so material rather than life-changing.

An identifiable infant received a definitive molecular diagnosis of a disorder the authors describe as frequently causing early death before age two. This triggered a same-day multidisciplinary meeting that conveyed the implications, coordinated gastrostomy tube placement and discussed long-term goals. The authors add that extensive genetic counseling is essential for parents desiring future children, given a 25% risk for the offspring of carrier parents. They do not report that counseling was delivered.

A single case in which preliminary results returned five days after the sample shipped, on 5 January 2023, with results on 10 January 2023. Life-changing benefit to one identifiable person: conversational communication with family and colleagues was restored. The 2026 follow-up documents over 3,800 hours of unsupervised home use, nearly two million words and continued full-time employment.

Cal Fire's Mount Laguna station received a verified alert at about 3 am. Its crews extinguished the fire at under a quarter acre. Cal Fire intelligence specialist Suzann Leininger says the system “is getting us time to react in a faster manner”.
Residents, property and forest around Mount Laguna were spared a larger fire. Captain Yeary's statement that it “could have been a devastating fire” is a judgment, not a proven counterfactual.
ICE reports several confirmed rescues of children from active abuse and 14 positive contacts. The number of rescues is unstated.
More than 100 leads disseminated and arrests of active abusers in the United States and Canada, per ICE and NBC.

The surgeons said that without urgent surgery he faced hemiplegia, speech loss, blurred vision or death. After the guided awake operation CT showed no residual clot. His movement, vision and cognition were normal and he went home on day six. The life-saving element belongs to the operation as a whole. The robot's own contribution was preserving function.

The passengers had been evacuated before the robot was used, and the suspect was taken into custody unharmed. None of the reports ties either outcome to the robot rather than to the man waking and leaving the bus.

A protective speed-reduction request for an endangered species over a defined area for about 15 days. No evidence that a strike was averted or that specific vessels complied.

An identifiable family received a definitive molecular cause of their son's death. They used it for IVF with preimplantation genetic testing to avoid a lethal disease recurring. Life-changing for the family, not life-saving for the patient.

Public attribution of the robocall's toolchain, corroborated by an academic team. No enforcement outcome in the sources is traced to the analysis.

After 14 years of complete quadriplegia the patient regained the ability to drink and eat by himself through the BCI-driven glove. The preprint reports neurological recovery: upper-limb motor score +5, ARAT +27, and the ability to hold objects without the BCI.

Silent, extensive, reversible ischemia from three-vessel disease was found and treated with quadruple bypass in an asymptomatic man. The authors' learning point is that such ischemia can end in exercise-induced sudden death. The counterfactual is not established.

Nader, Farritor and Schilliger shared a $700,000 prize announced by the organizers on 5 February 2024. Farritor had earlier won the First Letters prize for the first word.

Across the 10,889-woman evaluation Mia helped find 12% more cancers. The University of Aberdeen statement says this would not put more women through additional tests.
Participants completed small daily identifications without asking family. They rated descriptions 2.76/5 for satisfaction and 2.43/4 for trust on average. The app could not read text.

A stage I colorectal cancer inside a 1 to 1.5 cm adenoma was removed through the endoscope without surgery, per all three reports. A survival benefit is plausible for an early-stage cancer but is not demonstrated in the sources.

Two identifiable people (father and daughter) received a genetic long QT diagnosis and prophylactic beta-blockade against sudden arrhythmic death. A life-changing benefit, though no event was imminent.
